name: n4_list_alarm_classes
description: List the station's alarm classes with their priority per transition ({toOffnormal, toFault, toNormal, toAlert}, 0-255), whether each transition needs an acknowledgement (ack_required), their alarm counts, and the recipients each one routes to. Recipients are the alarm:AlarmRecipient components (console, email, station and others) and a class routes to one through a link from the class's alarm topic to the recipient's routeAlarm action; each class lists {path, type, link_name} of its recipients, recipients lists each recipient with the classes linked to it, and unresolved_links the routeAlarm links whose source is not a listed class. At most 50 recipients are read for links (recipients_truncated says when more exist). A value the station renders in another form is returned as its text. Read-only: two BQL selects at the station root and one tree load per class folder and recipient. To create a class, see the README recipe (n4_create_component, n4_set_slot, n4_create_link).
